mostWorthwhile.text: Bringing capillaries close to body cells was most worthwhile: it showed why thin walls and proximity matter for exchanging oxygen, nutrients and carbon dioxide.

leastWorthwhile.text: Lining the vein felt a little repetitive after lining the artery, though it made sense once the hint showed it was needed.

surprise.text: The vein picture showed how a contracting muscle and one-way valves help move blood forward; I hadn't expected the muscle to feature in the result.

arbitrary.text: The lining prerequisite was easy to miss when I tried adding valves first, but the unlined-wall picture and compatibility hint gave it a purpose.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: assembling the route was straightforward, and the exchange and valve pictures explained more than just which pieces fit.
